points.title: What: The Grid System is a modular, component-based architecture for dynamica...
points.statement: What: The Grid System is a modular, component-based architecture for dynamically building VR environments from JSON data. Rather than using monolithic code, the system uses focused components that each handle a specific responsibility.

points.title: The Grid System is AdaResearch's map runtime: it turns declarative map data i...
points.statement: The Grid System is AdaResearch's map runtime: it turns declarative map data into explorable VR spaces, and it is the main reason hundreds of maps can stay editable without hand-authoring every scene.
